correctness.rationale: For a six-periodic positive word a_i, every output is a 5-adic unit. The exact B_i=[[-1,5^e_i],[1,0]] product has eigenvalue 1, hence tr(P)=1+det(P); independent symbolic multiplication reproduces the claimed 6 singleton + 9 pair + 2 triple trace polynomial. Reduction modulo 5 over all 63 nonzero exponent-support patterns leaves only 13 patterns, precisely the rotations of 001011, 001101 and 111111. The all-positive case contradicts 6/5^5+9/5^4+2/5^3<1 after division by the product. For the remaining cases, the two exact multilinear equations f/g(A,B,C)=0 have f(5,5,5)=g(5,5,5)=0 and all partial derivatives negative for A,B,C>=5, forcing all three actual divisions to be by five (not higher powers); this is the essential unbounded step. Linear recurrences for each support have rank five and unique positive rational rays with primitive representatives as claimed. Exact independent substitution verifies both six-cycles. Mod-two Fibonacci dynamics excludes a positive primitive period-three orbit and periods not divisible by three. This is an all-positive classification; the finite support enumeration alone is not an arbitrary-entry proof.
